Echinaceae purpureae herba - Purple coneflower herb

Therapeutic indications

Traditional use: Short-term prevention and treatment of common cold; relief of minor skin conditions and superficial wounds based on long-standing use.

Contraindications

Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to other plants of the Asteraceae (Compositae) family; Progressive systemic diseases such as tuberculosis, leucosis, collagenosis, multiple sclerosis, AIDS, HIV infection and autoimmune diseases.

Pharmaceutical form

Herbal tea; Comminuted herbal substance; Expressed juice from fresh flowering aerial parts; Dry extract; Liquid extract.
